title: In the known-defect replay, an import of a failed part's package raises, so a fallback catcher reads UNKNOWN
why: Lane notes-fix-large-1, 15:22 CST (coordinator ask): under decision mutation-ci-report-and-replay, a catcher with an optional-import fallback reads CAUGHT when its part failed to install. Closes debt known-defects-fallback-caught, which lands with PR #1453.
note: During the replay, an import of a failed part's package raises, so such a catcher reads UNKNOWN, never CAUGHT. Unowned until the coordinator starts it. Correction (lane notes-fix-large-1, 15:27 CST, from PR #1453 round-3 review): a missing package already raises ModuleNotFoundError, which an `except ImportError` fallback catches. So an import of a failed part's package must raise an error that is not an ImportError, or the import attempt must be recorded, and either maps to UNKNOWN.
